subject: Making line color consistent when hovering over lines

messages.author: 06fe2386ffb8b7dc
messages.subject: Making line color consistent when hovering over lines
parts:
Hi,  I am interested in making some interactive line graphs and wondered if it's possible to make them in ggvis.

In this example I'm trying to somewhat replicate the following chart:

http://next.mlssoccer.com/standings/weekly

As you can see, when you hover over a line that line is shown specifically in color and the other lines fade.  I don't think this is possible in ggivs yet?     I would also be happy in just having each line thicken and keeping it's current color.

Here are some example data:

mydf <- structure(list(team1 = structure(c(4L, 1L, 4L, 2L, 4L, 3L, 1L, 
2L, 1L, 3L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 4L, 2L, 4L, 3L, 4L, 2L, 1L, 3L, 1L, 3L, 
2L), .Label = c("AX", "DU", "MP", "OS"), class = "factor"), matchno = c(1L, 
1L, 2L, 1L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 2L, 3L, 3L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 5L, 4L, 
6L, 5L, 5L, 5L, 6L, 6L, 6L), rank = c(1L, 3L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 2L, 
3L, 4L, 2L, 2L, 3L, 1L, 3L, 1L, 4L, 1L, 2L, 1L, 4L, 3L, 2L, 3L, 
2L, 4L)), .Names = c("team1", "matchno", "rank"), class = c("grouped_df", 
"tbl_df", "tbl", "data.frame"), row.names = c(NA, -24L), vars = list(
    matchno), drop = TRUE, indices = list(c(0L, 1L, 3L, 5L), 
    c(2L, 6L, 7L, 9L), c(4L, 8L, 10L, 11L), c(12L, 13L, 14L, 
    16L), c(15L, 18L, 19L, 20L), c(17L, 21L, 22L, 23L)), group_sizes = c(4L, 
4L, 4L, 4L, 4L, 4L), biggest_group_size = 4L, labels = structure(list(
    matchno = 1:6), class = "data.frame", row.names = c(NA, -6L
), .Names = "matchno", vars = list(matchno)))


mydf  %>%
  ggvis(~matchno,~rank, stroke = ~team1) %>%
  layer_points(size := 50, size.hover := 200, fill = ~team1) %>%
  layer_lines(stroke.hover := "red", strokeWidth.hover := 4, strokeWidth := 2) %>%
  add_axis("x", title="Match number",  subdivide = 0, values = seq(1, 6, by = 1), format="####") %>%
  add_axis("y", title="Rank", subdivide = 0, values = seq(1, 4, by = 1), format='####') %>%
  scale_numeric("y", reverse=TRUE)


So my questions would be:

1) is it possible to change stroke.hover such that it is not set to just one color "red" but will be the same color as the line that is hovered over (i.e. red, orange, green, blue)

2) is it possible to make the other lines more opaque if another line is hovered over?

3)  if one hovers over a line and then move the mouse over a data point the change in line thickness/color recedes back to the original line color and thickness.   Is it possible to keep the line thicker when a point on that line is hovered over?



Thank you !

James Curley
